hero.intro: De la Cruz. Junior full stack developer, graduate in cross-platform and web development.

about.title: About me
about.text: I enjoy the interface as much as the logic that holds it up.
about.skills: I work with Vue, React and Node.js, with MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. I use Docker and GitHub Actions to deploy, and I have made games with Unity.
